text: Following my recent appointment as Chair of the Board of TO Live, I am no longer able to continue in my previous role as Chair of the Human Resources and Stakeholder Relations Committee. I have spoken with Board Member Robyn Citizen, who has agreed to serve in this capacity. I am therefore pleased to recommend her appointment as Chair of the Human Resources and Stakeholder Relations Committee.
The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Appointed Robyn Citizen as Chair of the Human Resources and Stakeholder Relations Committee, effective immediately upon approval.
